CheckTitle: Security Groups with High Risk ports (1-1024) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to High Risk ports.
Risk: Opening known dangerous ports (e.g., for unencrypted protocols or management services) dramatically increases the likelihood of rapid, automated exploitation and system compromise.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
